text: On it: the balancers in middleware/proxy.go panic when a balancer has no targets (rand.Intn(0) / modulo by zero). A subagent is fixing the balancers + ProxyWithConfig to fail gracefully, and verifying with the full middleware test suite. ETA ~10 min.

Bug #2 (router.go, no-routable-path handling): a subagent is investigating and fixing it now; ETA ~12 min. Bug #1 (proxy.go zero-target balancer) is fixed and under independent verification — will confirm shortly.

Bug #1 FIXED and independently verified. middleware/proxy.go: both balancers now return nil when there are no targets (randomBalancer.Next no longer calls rand.Intn(0); roundRobinBalancer.Next no longer does %0 and is now mutex-guarded), and ProxyWithConfig returns echo.ErrServiceUnavailable (HTTP 503) when the balancer yields no target, instead of dereferencing a nil target. Zero-target balancers now return 503 with no panic. Full suite (go build/vet/test ./... incl. -race on proxy tests) passes; no test files touched.
Bug #3 (context.go Scheme() not validating X-Forwarded-Proto): a subagent is on it now; ETA ~12 min. Bug #2 (router.go) still in progress.
Bug #4 (bind.go: binding into map[string][]string): a subagent is on it now; ETA ~12 min. Bugs #2 (router.go) and #3 (context.go Scheme) are still in progress.
Bug #5 (group.go: middleware for multiple groups on the same path): a subagent is on it now; ETA ~12 min. Bugs #2 (router.go), #3 (context.go) and #4 (bind.go) are still in progress.
Bug #6 (middleware/compress.go: empty response body with gzip): a subagent is on it now; ETA ~12 min. Bugs #2 (router.go), #3 (context.go), #4 (bind.go) and #5 (group.go) are still in progress.

Bug #4 FIXED and verified. bind.go: bindData's map branch blindly did SetMapIndex(k, v[0]), which panicked for map[string][]string ("value of type string is not assignable to type []string") and dropped extra values. It now binds map[string]string (first value), map[string][]string (whole slice) and map[string]interface{} (slice), and ignores unsupported map types instead of panicking. Full suite green (go build/vet/test ./...); no test files touched.

Bug #3 FIXED and verified. context.go: Scheme() returned X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme verbatim, so bogus values were returned as the scheme. It now validates each header (http/https, case-insensitive) and ignores invalid values, falling back to the next source and finally to the TLS state. Precedence unchanged; full suite (incl. -race) green; no test files touched.
Bug #2 (router.go no-routable-path) is still being worked on; ETA ~5 min. Bugs #5 (group.go) and #6 (compress.go) are also in progress.
